targets.expr: count(max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", phase="Running"} == 1)) or vector(0)

count(max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{pod=~"logs-collector-.*", phase="Running", cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace"} == 1) and on (cluster, namespace, pod) (time() - kube_pod_start_time{pod=~"logs-collector-.*", cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace"} > 300) unless on (cluster, namespace, pod) (sum by (cluster, namespace, pod) (rate(otelcol_exporter_sent_log_records_total{cluster="$cluster",job="$namespace/opentelemetry-collector-logs"}[15m])) > 0)) or vector(0)

count(max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", phase="Pending"} == 1)) or vector(0)

max by (cluster, namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"logs-collector-.*"}) and on (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", phase="Running"} == 1)

max by (cluster, namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~".*operator.*"}) and on (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", phase="Running"} == 1)
